blocks.text: BAROMETERS ML-102-B, ML-102-D, ML-102-E, ML-102-F, AND ML-316/TM
This reprint includes all changes in effect at the time of publication - Changes 2 and 3.
19.7 Quarterly Preventive Maintenance Checks and Services Chart-Con't.
3 Modifications Check DA Pam 310-4 to determine whether new applicable MWO's have been published. All URGENT MWO's must be applied immediately. All NORMAL MWO's must be scheduled (TM 38-750).

Check accuracy of barometer readings by comparing its readings with those of a barometer (mercury or aneroid type) known to be accurate. If readings are not within approximately 0.02 or 0.03 inch of each other, turn in barometer for higher echelon maintenance.
